# Port City Christmas Lights

> Christmas light hanging for homes in Greater Saint John, New Brunswick, Canada (Saint John, Rothesay, Quispamsis and Grand Bay-Westfield). A one-person local business run by Karan, who hangs the lights homeowners already own. Jobs start at $200 CAD. Same-day appointments are available.

## Contact

- Phone and text: 506-799-2790 (+1-506-799-2790)
- Hours: 7 days a week, 8am to 8pm
- Website: https://portcitychristmas.github.io/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/portcitychristmaslights
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/portcitychristmaslights/

## Service

- Hangs the customer's own Christmas lights on single and two-storey homes
- Tests every strand before it goes up
- Uses clips made for gutters and shingles: no nails, screws or drilling
- Runs cords neatly to the outlet and sets up the customer's timer
- Can supply lights if the customer has none or not enough; these are priced separately and the customer keeps them
- Hanging season runs from early November into December

## Pricing (CAD)

- Minimum job: $200
- Mini-home / small bungalow: $200
- Bungalow: $250
- Large bungalow / split-level: $350
- Two-storey: custom quote from a photo
- Attached garage roofline: +$75
- Bushes: +$30 each
- Small trees (up to 8 ft): +$50 each
- Railings: +$30 each
- Windows: +$25 each

Final price is confirmed after a photo or address check, usually within a day and without a visit. No deposit. Payment by Interac e-Transfer or cash once the lights are up.

## Service areas

- Saint John (East, West, North and South End, Millidgeville, Lakewood and more)
- Rothesay
- Quispamsis (Hammond River to Meenan's Cove)
- Grand Bay-Westfield
- Just outside these areas: text to ask

## How to book

1. Use the instant estimator on the website, or text your address
2. Text a photo of the front of the house to confirm the price
3. Pick a date (same-day often available)
4. Leave the lights by the door or in the garage; the customer doesn't need to be home
